ci: clone prisma/orm after the repository rename (#5859)

GitHub renamed `prisma/prisma` to `prisma/orm`. Git still follows the
redirect from the old clone URL, but the redirect breaks permanently if
the old name is ever reused. This PR switches our references to the new
name.

## Changes

- **Makefile** (`ensure-prisma-present`): clone
`https://github.com/prisma/orm.git` instead of
`https://github.com/prisma/prisma.git`, in both the echoed command and
the real one. Update the divergence warning to say `prisma/orm`. Every
query-compiler CI job reaches this clone through `make dev-*-qc` →
`build-driver-adapters`.
- **README** (CI section): refer to `prisma/orm` where the text means
the renamed repo. References to `prisma/prisma-engines` are unchanged.

## Out of scope

Code comments that link to `github.com/prisma/prisma/issues/...` stay as
they are. The redirect covers them and they are historical references.
